start: A gym member: any screen of the app that fails while drawing

user_sees: 'Something went wrong on this screen.' and 'Your workout is safe.'
Buttons: 'Try again', 'Go back' (when there is a screen behind) and 'Go to Workout'
must_not: The app closing
Error text or code shown to the member
The bottom of the app or other screens broken too

user_sees: The screen drawn afresh and working
must_not: The old broken state kept
Data typed on other screens lost

start: A gym member: a screen has failed and shows the crash message

user_sees: The screen before
must_not: The crash message on the screen before as well
The app closing

steps.action: Open the failing screen again, tap 'Go to Workout'
user_sees: The Workout tab
must_not: Being left on the crash message
A back press returning into an endless crash

start: A gym member: the frame of the app itself fails while drawing (not one screen)

user_sees: The same two lines with only 'Try again'
must_not: 'Go back' or 'Go to Workout' buttons that cannot work
The splash screen left up for ever

user_sees: The app drawn afresh
must_not: Saved workouts or the open workout gone

start: A gym member: a screen that fails every time it is drawn

user_sees: The same crash message again
must_not: The app closing
The app freezing in a loop of retries

steps.action: Tap 'Try again' five more times, then 'Go to Workout'
user_sees: The Workout tab, working
must_not: No way out of the failing screen

start: A gym member: a workout is open with three sets logged; a screen fails

user_sees: 'Your workout is safe.'
must_not: The rest timer or the open workout stopped

steps.action: Tap 'Go to Workout' and open the workout
user_sees: The open workout with all three sets
must_not: A set missing
The workout ended or doubled

steps.action: Open the failed screen again later
user_sees: The screen works, or shows the crash message again
must_not: A crash message stuck on a screen that now works

start: A gym member: a workout is open while saving is failing (the save banner is up) and a screen fails

user_sees: The two fixed lines only
must_not: 'Your workout is safe.' said while the workout cannot be saved
Error details, a name, a phone number or workout data on the crash screen

user_sees: The screen, or the crash message again
must_not: A crash report sent with workouts, name, gym or phone details in it
